say:1:1421611001:1.text: Ewan, have you collected the other ingredients needed for the Mystic Dew?
say:1:1421611001:1.source_cn: 埃文，秘露需要的其他材料你准备好了吧？

say:2:1421611002:1.text: My plan was... Oh, no! I meant to collect them after meeting you back in the city! Now I'm completely out of time!
say:2:1421611002:1.source_cn: 我提前计划……完了！我之前计划和你在王城见面后去准备的...

say:3:1421611003:1.text: I need to get some <style="highlight">honey amber</style> at the Goodwill Market and also some <style="highlight">coconut oil</style>! It's gotten so late... the stall selling the oil is likely shut by now!
say:3:1421611003:1.source_cn: 要去蒙惠市集买<style=highlight>蜂琥珀...

say:4:1421611004:1.text: Don't panic, Ewan. I recall Delina saying she had some unused coconut oil. I'll go ask if she can spare some for you.
say:4:1421611004:1.source_cn: 别着急，我记得德琳说过她那里有没用完的香椰油，我去帮你问问！

say:6:1421611005:1.text: Words can't express how grateful I am! Let's split up, I'll head to the market and try my luck there. We should all meet back there later.
say:6:1421611005:1.source_cn: 言语已经无法表达我的感激了……那我们分头行动，我去市集...
